Minor: expanded issue row is missing outer data-testid='issue-detail' wrapper (the inner testids like issue-suggested-fix are present).

critical.issue: duplicate_calls rule recall=0.6513 (68/195 ground-truth duplicates missed). Root cause in backend/costguard/rules/duplicate_calls.py: uses zip(group, group[1:]) which only compares adjacent pairs — when 3+ duplicates exist with the middle gap > short_window_s, the trailing ones are missed even though they duplicate an earlier ok response. Consider comparing each item against the last ok response in the group, not just its immediate predecessor.

ui_bugs.issue: The expanded panel container does not carry the required data-testid='issue-detail'. Inner testids (issue-suggested-fix, etc.) are present, but the outer wrapper is missing per spec.

rca of the issue: duplicate_calls recall shortfall: In backend/costguard/rules/duplicate_calls.py the loop `for prev, cur in zip(group, group[1:])` only flags requests whose immediate predecessor in the same (provider, method, req_hash) group is <= short_window_s away. In synthetic bursts of 3+ duplicates, if the internal gaps stretch beyond short_window_s while later calls remain within a short window of an earlier successful response, those are missed. Fix: iterate maintaining a rolling anchor (the last ok response) and flag any subsequent call whose gap from that anchor is <= short_window_s, or reset the anchor to the current call if the gap exceeds the window.
